objective: Test one unified shadow execution path across local-only execution, reuse of an already verified external integration, and bounded discovery of a genuinely new public API for a new domain-specific goal.

cases.local_goal: Without external data or network access, validate the local execution path and return the string LOCAL_ONLY_OK.
cases.existing_integration_goal: Retrieve one fresh read-only JSON payload from a public API and summarize its top-level structure.
cases.new_api_goal: Retrieve a fresh public science and geographic data JSON payload from a suitable public API and summarize its top-level structure.
